data.title: Steadfast Shareholders Vote in Favour of Proposed Acquisition
data.description:
Steadfast Group Limited ( (AU:SDF) ) just unveiled an update.

Steadfast Group Limited (ASX: SDF) has an underwriting agencies business segment.

Steadfast shareholders voted in favour of the proposed acquisition of the company by Starboard BidCo, an entity indirectly owned by funds managed or advised by Dragoneer and KKR. The Scheme Resolution passed with 99.58% of votes cast in favour and 94.62% of shareholders present and voting supporting it.

data.title: Metro Mining Agrees Senior Debt Amortisation Restructure
data.description:
Metro Mining Limited ( (AU:MMI) ) has shared an announcement.

Metro Mining is an independent bauxite producer and explorer operating its 100%-owned Bauxite Hills Mine in Far North Queensland. It produces high-alumina bauxite for direct shipment to customers, with bauxite used to make aluminium.

Metro agreed with Nebari to restructure amortisation of the largest senior-debt tranche, about US$17.8 million, making it interest-only until a bullet payment in December 2027; about US$23.2 million remains to be amortised across the two tranches. Other facility terms, including the coupon rate, remain unchanged.

data.title: TerraCom Reports 2026 AGM Resolution Results
data.description:
TerraCom Limited ( (AU:TER) ) has issued an update.

data.title: JZR Gold Updates Vila Nova Gold Processing Optimization
data.description:
The latest update is out from Jazz Resources ( (TSE:JZR) ).

JZR Gold said initial processing trials at the RBM precious-metals refining and recovery plant in São Paulo, Brazil, provided metallurgical insights and identified competing chemical reactions involving cyanide, iron and other reactive metals that can increase reagent consumption and interfere with gold dissolution.

Working with RBM, JZR is implementing pre-aeration and oxygen sparging in the leaching circuit to improve oxidation conditions and dissolved oxygen availability, while incorporating a filter press to improve separation of gold-bearing solutions. The enhancements are designed to improve gold dissolution, optimize cyanide consumption, potentially improve overall recovery, reduce water consumption and increase operational efficiency.

data.title: Credit Clear Shareholders Approve Constitutional Amendments
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Credit Clear Limited ( (AU:CCR) ).

Credit Clear Limited reported that shareholders approved amendments to its constitution through a special resolution at the annual general meeting held on 24 November 2026. The changes reinstate proportional takeover approval provisions for three years from the meeting’s close and remove the company’s ability to make or deliver shareholder payments by cheque.

data.title: Nations Royalty Reports Fiscal 2027 Results, Names Alex Morrison Board Chair
data.description:
An announcement from Nations Royalty Corp. ( (TSE:NRC) ) is now available.

Nations Royalty Corp. holds Indigenous royalty interests in producing and development-stage mining projects and has an Indigenous Benefits Agreement (IBA) Advisory practice, with its portfolio focused on northwestern British Columbia. The company reported C$2.64 million in royalty revenue and C$0.21 million in net income for the six months ended September 30, 2026, while second-quarter revenue was C$0.43 million.

Nations Royalty said six-month revenue increased 382% year over year and that Brucejack royalties drove first-half profitability; it held C$16.7 million in cash and cash equivalents and no long-term debt at September 30. Alex Morrison was appointed chair effective immediately, while Seabridge announced substantial completion and successful energization of the Treaty Creek Terminal on August 27, 2026, and Cambria Gold Mines received final permits and commenced construction of the Red Mountain access road.
